infothequecore: Name of the special page and extension, shown in the UI and in [[Special:SpecialPages]].
infothequecore-select-form-label: Label for the content-type selector on Special:InfothequeCore.
infothequecore-select-form-help: Help text shown under the content-type selector.
infothequecore-select-form-submit: Submit button label on the content-type selector step.
infothequecore-field-titre: Field label: non-repeating table title, shared by the Téléchargements-logiciels, Manuels and Configurations forms.
infothequecore-field-edition: Field label: edition name, Téléchargements-logiciels form (maps to editionN).
infothequecore-field-version: Field label: version number, reused across Téléchargements-logiciels, Manuels and Pilotes forms (maps to versionN).
infothequecore-field-langue: Field label: language, reused across Téléchargements-logiciels and Manuels forms (maps to langueN).
infothequecore-field-description: Field label: free description, reused across Téléchargements-logiciels and Manuels forms (maps to descriptionN).
infothequecore-field-format-media: Field label: media icon picker, Téléchargements-logiciels form (maps to formatN, wrapped into a [[Fichier:]] link).
infothequecore-field-image: Field label: photo picker, Téléchargements-logiciels form (maps to imageN, wrapped into a [[Fichier:]] link).
infothequecore-field-liens: Field label: download links, reused across Téléchargements-logiciels and Manuels forms (maps to liensN).
infothequecore-field-nom-document: Field label: document name, Manuels form (maps to editionN).
infothequecore-field-edition-document: Field label: document edition/date, Manuels form (maps to versionN).
infothequecore-field-format-document: Field label: document type icon picker, Manuels form (maps to formatN, wrapped into a [[Fichier:]] link).
infothequecore-field-variante: Field label: variant name, Configurations form (maps to varianteN).
infothequecore-field-processeur: Field label: processor, Configurations form (maps to processeurN).
infothequecore-field-ram: Field label: memory, Configurations form (maps to ramN).
infothequecore-field-stockage: Field label: storage, Configurations form (maps to stockageN).
infothequecore-field-graphics: Field label: graphics card, Configurations form (maps to graphicsN).
infothequecore-field-autres: Field label: free notes, Configurations form (maps to autresN).
infothequecore-field-nom-pilote: Field label: driver name, Pilotes form (maps to nomN).
infothequecore-field-type-pilote: Field label: driver type, Pilotes form (maps to typeN).
infothequecore-field-os-pilote: Field label: target OS, Pilotes form (maps to osN).
infothequecore-field-date-pilote: Field label: driver date, Pilotes form (maps to dateN).
infothequecore-field-fichier-pilote: Field label: uploaded file picker, Pilotes form (maps to fichierN, bare file name, no [[Fichier:]] wrapper).
infothequecore-unknown-form: Error shown when the URL subpage doesn't match a known schema id.
infothequecore-back-to-selector: Subtitle link back to the content-type selector, shown on every schema form.
infothequecore-field-target-page: Field label: the wiki page the generated table will be written to.
infothequecore-row-section: Heading shown above each repeatable row block. $1 is the row number.
infothequecore-preview-button: Submit button label on the data-entry step, leading to the preview step.
infothequecore-preview-heading: Heading above the rendered preview of the generated table.
infothequecore-preview-wikitext-heading: Heading above the raw generated wikitext block.
infothequecore-page-exists-warning: Warning shown instead of the publish button when the target page already exists. $1 is the page's prefixed text.
infothequecore-publish-button: Submit button label on the preview step, only shown when the target page doesn't exist yet.
infothequecore-invalid-target-page: Error shown when the submitted target page name doesn't parse as a valid title.
infothequecore-bad-token: Error shown when the CSRF edit token on the publish confirmation doesn't match.
infothequecore-confirm-missing-data: Error shown when the publish confirmation step is missing the target page or wikitext.
infothequecore-edit-summary: Automatic edit summary used when the assistant creates a page.
infothequecore-save-failed: Error shown when PageUpdater::saveRevision does not succeed.
infothequecore-save-success: Success message after the assistant creates a page. $1 is the page's prefixed text.
infothequecore-view-page: Link text to the page just created.
infothequecore-error-no-rows: Validation error when no row's key field (e.g. edition/variante/nom) was filled in.
infothequecore-error-field-required: Validation error for a required field left empty on a row that is otherwise in use. $1 is the row number, $2 is the field's label.
infothequecore-insert-context-new: Shown above the insert-mode form when no existing table was found on the page. $1 is the page name, supplied by the editor button.
infothequecore-insert-context-existing: Shown above the insert-mode form when an existing table was found and parsed from the page. $1 is the page name.
infothequecore-insert-button: Button label on the preview step in insert mode, in place of infothequecore-publish-button. Purely client-side: sends the wikitext back to the opener window via postMessage.
infothequecore-insert-hint: Reassurance text shown under infothequecore-insert-button, explaining that nothing is saved to the wiki until the user saves the page themselves.
infothequecore-editor-trigger: Label of the single trigger button injected in the source editor, which opens a dropdown of the 4 assistant forms.
